description: Tests first: canonical Person, explicit non-Person kind/subject, missing/invalid/conflicting identity and property invariants. Own identity contract and trusted producers; preserve permissions; no downstream nil-to-system fallback. Mock only external edges. Update identity docs. Approved schema implementation follows audit of current producers.

comments.text: Tests-first baseline confirmed: 2 properties, 50 tests, 10 expected failures (missing contract and dropped origin actors). Implementing strict validator plus trusted BO/cron/channel origins and lifecycle propagation. Channel finalization belongs at Engine ingress after Person resolution. No UI behavior change; unit/integration sufficient. Main owns mix q; no issue closure or git delivery actions.

Shared ExecutionActor.validate/1 and identity/1 now available at agreed path. Contract rejects person:nil (declared malformed), conflicting aliases, legacy/person mismatch, and Person + nonperson declaration; preserves metadata; normalize_id rules unchanged. No constructor added. Important coordination: validate raw actors before ActorNormalizer can erase duplicate atom/string keys. Focused verification currently 2 properties + 275 tests passing. Audit leaves DispatchEvent machine:true permission policy unchanged/out of scope; workflow.created has no initiating actor in current call chain, so no fake system fallback introduced.

Final focused validation: MIX_ENV=test mix coveralls over execution_actor, actor_normalizer, incoming_message_router, workflow_run_agent, cron_trigger_worker, dispatch_event, workflow_run_helpers, chat_live, and engine/workflows tests: 3 properties, 280 tests, 0 failures. ExecutionActor 100%, CronTriggerWorker 100%, WorkflowRunHelpers 100%, IncomingMessageRouter 96.7%, ChatLive 97.8%, DispatchEvent 95.3%; WorkflowRunAgent 94.6%, Workflows 58.3% whole-file in this partial suite. Exception rationale: broad pre-existing workflow engine/context branches are outside identity producer scope; main should check aggregate coverage with full quality gate rather than expand this task into workflow CRUD/composition coverage. mix format run scoped after edits. mix q deliberately reserved for main. Bridges audited: CommunicationBridge stamps routing config before Engine dispatch, so finalizing channel subjects at IncomingMessageRouter is trusted; no bridge edits required. Lifecycle run events copy initiating source_event.actor, including interruption and build failure. No commits/push/worktree/branch operations or issue closures.

title: [zaq-yws] Define strict shared execution identity and trusted producers
